components.update_policy: Only change the pinned release after checksum and release-note review. The official Windows executable includes yt-dlp-ejs.
runtime_dependencies: The official standalone executable has no Python runtime dependency and bundles yt-dlp-ejs.
Deno 2.3.0 or later is required for full YouTube JavaScript challenge support; this project bundles Deno and passes its explicit path with --js-runtimes deno:<path>.
FFmpeg and FFprobe are required for stream merging and media conversion; this project bundles them through the ffmpeg component.

components.license: MIT for Deno; source-tree notices also cover bundled TypeScript (Apache-2.0), Node type definitions, Undici and WebGPU (MIT). The release ZIP has no notice bundle for compiled/transitive Rust/V8 dependencies.
components.update_policy: Pin an official Deno release archive, verify SHA-256, and update with the yt-dlp runtime compatibility floor checked.
runtime_dependencies: Standalone Windows x86_64 MSVC executable; no separate JavaScript runtime dependency.
Used by yt-dlp for JavaScript challenge solving on YouTube; yt-dlp receives the bundled executable's absolute path.

components.license: LGPL-3.0-or-later shared build (ffmpeg -L; archive LICENSE.txt); --enable-version3 is set and GPL is not enabled. Retain all upstream notices and shared libraries.
components.update_policy: Pin the immutable GitHub release asset ID and digest, inspect the build configuration and license files, then refresh bundled DLLs and notices together.
runtime_dependencies: The archive's bin DLLs are required by ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe and are staged beside both executables.
FFmpeg and FFprobe are optional for basic extraction but required for stream merging and media conversion.
